narr: Cold low pressure passing overhead helped trigger isolated thunderstorms over the Mojave Desert. A couple of storms caused damage.
ev: Highway 127 was impassable due to being flooded with 1.5 feet of water plus rocks and debris. One car with four occupants was stuck and water was coming into the car.
lsr: California Highway Patrol reports roadway flooding with rocks, debris, and water across Highway 127 with vehicles unable to get through.
